why: The Brumer-Stark conjecture itself was proved by Dasgupta-Kakde-Silliman-Wang in Oct 2023, pre-snapshot, but post-snapshot papers (Honnor, Jan 2024, resolving a root-of-unity ambiguity in the Brumer-Stark units formula; Dasgupta-Honnor-Spieß, reported Dec 2025, proving equivalence of three formulas for Brumer-Stark units) continue refining the explicit units side of the same conjecture; unclear whether this counts as moving 'the problem' (already proved) versus a related formula/refinement question, and I could not fully pin down or verify the Dec 2025 item's date/venue.
